title: Cinema Entry
description:
Read the age (line 1) and, only if the age is 12 or more, read `yes` or `no` for "has a ticket?" (line 2).

- Age under 12: print `Needs a guardian` (there is no second input line).
- Age 12+ with a ticket: print `Enter`.
- Age 12+ without a ticket: print `Buy a ticket`.
starter_code:
age = int(input())
# Ask about the ticket only when age >= 12
